rules.requirement: DESIGN.md front-matter equals the rendering of src/styles/tokens.css through design/frontmatter.json.
rules.source: AGENTS.md: tokens.css is the only hand-edited token source
rules.fix: Edit src/styles/tokens.css (values) or design/frontmatter.json (mapping), then run pnpm design:tokens.

rules.requirement: design/generated/catalog.md equals the rendering of the current contracts and rules.
rules.fix: Run pnpm design:catalog after changing design/ contracts or rules.

rules.requirement: Every component contract names a real package export, and each declared variant and state renders its declared class and attributes.
rules.fix: Correct the contract to match the implementation, or change the implementation through a reviewed public-contract change.

rules.requirement: Screens do not put literal colors in style or className; they use semantic tokens.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Do's and Don'ts: don't add literal theme colors
rules.fix: Use var(--gdg-*) or a semantic utility such as text-muted / bg-surface.

rules.requirement: Screens import UI only from @gdgjp/design-system (or the package's own src in its examples), not from the primitives it wraps.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Components: Icons wraps Lucide so consumers import only from @gdgjp/design-system; Radix is the interaction foundation
rules.fix: Import the wrapped component (Icons, Toaster, ThemeProvider, Dialog, ...) from @gdgjp/design-system.

rules.requirement: Every IconButton has a nonempty aria-label.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Actions: IconButton requires an accessible label
rules.fix: Add aria-label describing the action, e.g. aria-label="メニューを開く".

rules.requirement: A RadioGroup has an accessible name from an enclosing FormField/Field or its own aria-label/aria-labelledby.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Forms and selection: give the group an accessible name
rules.fix: Wrap it in FormField with a label, or pass aria-labelledby pointing at a visible heading.

rules.requirement: In the invalid state the input has aria-invalid=true, its aria-describedby includes a visible error message, and focus is on that input.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Do's and Don'ts: put resolvable errors next to the affected field
rules.fix: Pass the message through FormField error and focus the first invalid field on submit.

rules.requirement: Repeated activation while a save is pending sends exactly one request; the submit control is aria-busy and the entered value stays visible.
rules.fix: Use Button loading for the submit action and ignore submissions while a request is in flight.

rules.requirement: A rejected save keeps the edited value, shows a danger Alert, and a retry reaches the success state.
rules.fix: Keep form state on failure; render Alert tone=danger with the retry path.

rules.requirement: Each scenario state shows at most one visible primary Button.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Actions: one primary action per screen
rules.fix: Give secondary actions variant="outline" or "ghost" (Button defaults to primary).

rules.requirement: At every scenario viewport, including the long-name data, the page has no horizontal overflow and the submit button is fully inside the viewport width.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Layout: overflow must not expand the page horizontally
rules.fix: Let content wrap (Inline, min-width: 0) instead of fixing widths.

rules.requirement: axe (wcag2a, wcag2aa) reports no violations in each state and theme, with the documented primary/secondary contrast exclusion.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Colors: primary/secondary are action surfaces with a documented 3:1 control threshold
rules.fix: Fix the reported node; do not widen the exclusion without a decision record.

rules.requirement: Keyboard alone can reach the name input and the submit button in reading order, focus is visibly outlined, and Enter in the input submits.
rules.fix: Use a form element with Button type="submit"; do not remove the focus outline.

rules.requirement: A member can tell what to change, which action saves it, and whether it was saved — in both themes and both viewports.

verification.evidence: screenshots of every state, theme, and viewport in the run directory

rules.fix: Review the screenshots against the brief; record the judgment in design/decisions.md.

rules.requirement: Every Input and Textarea has a label: an enclosing FormField/Field, or its own aria-label/aria-labelledby. A placeholder is not a label.
rules.source: DESIGN.md Forms and selection: each item has a visible or programmatic label; design/components/input.json content
rules.fix: Wrap the control in FormField with a label, or give a search-style field aria-label (for example aria-label="タグを検索").

decision.reason: Placeholder-only inputs (tinyurl tags search) are unlabeled; accepted as MUST with the known wrapper false positive. Re-based after a formatting-only change invalidated the first proposal.
